# AHADEX Tools

> AHADEX Tools is a privacy-first, 100% client-side browser tool suite designed for everyday digital tasks such as image editing, document generation, and design utility processing. All files and user data are processed locally in the browser; nothing is uploaded to a server.

## Core Tools

- [Color Picker](https://ahadex.online/tools/color-picker): Pick colors from images and get HEX, RGB, and HSL codes instantly.
- [WebP Converter](https://ahadex.online/tools/webp-converter): Convert WebP images to JPG or PNG instantly in your browser. Processed locally.
- [Image Resizer](https://ahadex.online/tools/image-resizer): Resize and scale images to exact pixel dimensions instantly. Private, client-side processing.
- [Image to PDF](https://ahadex.online/tools/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a single PDF file instantly. Private, client-side processing.
- [Photo QR Code](https://ahadex.online/tools/photo-qr): Add a real, scannable QR badge to any photo — WhatsApp, Facebook, WiFi, and more.
- [Visiting Card Maker](https://ahadex.online/tools/visiting-card): Design professional visiting cards in seconds. 20 premium templates — front & back. Free, private, exports PNG/JPG.
- [CV Builder](https://ahadex.online/tools/cv-builder): Build a professional CV in minutes. Real A4 templates, live preview, selectable-text PDF export, auto-save and full browser-side privacy.
